chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
A man should not perform salat while there is an iron ring on his hand.

key_terms.الرَّجُلُ: the man; the male worshipper addressed by the ruling
key_terms.حَدِيدٍ: iron; the material of the ring mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: The Messenger of Allah, the Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.يَدِهِ: his hand; the place where the ring is worn
key_terms.يُصَلِّي: performs salat; engages in ritual prayer

ai.seo_question: Can a man perform salat while wearing an iron ring?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal instruction regarding salat, prohibiting a man from praying while wearing an iron ring. It falls under the jurisprudence of permissible and impermissible attire or items worn during prayer.
